purpose: Post-reveal descriptive sensitivity analysis of the #173 House Journal validation result. This plan is explicitly not confirmatory: the 2025-2026 holdout outcomes have already been revealed. Its role is to distinguish unconditional residual replication from period-adjusted incremental signal and to define the next prospective test without changing production behavior.

frozenFinding.note: The predeclared unconditional sign/magnitude replication succeeded. This post-reveal analysis does not relabel that result; it asks the different question of whether companion substitution adds residual signal relative to contemporaneous non-companion cases.

diagnostics.definition: Within development and holdout separately, compute companion-substitution residual minus non-companion residual using both decisive-member weighting and equal-case weighting.
diagnostics.interpretation: Positive values indicate more Quick underprediction on companion cases than on contemporaneous non-companion cases. Sign stability across periods is more relevant to incremental signal than the already-completed unconditional replication test.

diagnostics.definition: Within each period, compute companion-substitution residual minus the overall period residual using decisive-member weighting and equal-case weighting.
diagnostics.interpretation: This centers out broad period-level Quick calibration drift.

diagnostics.definition: Compute holdout minus development change in D1 and D2. Report sign reversals explicitly.
diagnostics.interpretation: Large sign-changing movement is evidence against treating the mechanic as a stable standalone correction.

diagnostics.definition: Report every companion-substitution case residual in both periods and counts above/below zero. No case may be removed as an outlier.
diagnostics.interpretation: A mean effect driven by a small number of unanimous or near-unanimous votes should remain visibly heterogeneous.

diagnostics.definition: Apply the same period-specific incremental contrast to author_added, the administrative-only confounding sentinel frozen in #173.
diagnostics.interpretation: If the negative control also appears strong or unstable, that reinforces confounding/calibration-shift concerns. It can never become actionable.

decisionBoundary.promotionRule: No result from this post-reveal sensitivity analysis can create a production correction. Companion substitution remains non-actionable until an independently frozen prospective experiment evaluates an incremental within-period contrast.

prospective2027_2028.caseEnrollment: Enroll every otherwise-eligible Minnesota House passage forecast prospectively before the selected floor vote. Enrollment may not depend on outcome, Journal source availability, or companion-substitution presence. The pre-vote Quick member probabilities and the frozen deterministic Journal mechanic classification must be timestamped before outcome reveal.
prospective2027_2028.primaryEstimand: Within-session companion-substitution minus non-companion Quick signed residual contrast, reported both decisive-member weighted and equal-case weighted.
prospective2027_2028.replicationRule: Eligible only after the minimum companion case/member counts are met. Both member-weighted and equal-case companion-minus-noncompanion residual contrasts must be positive, and the member-weighted contrast must be at least +0.02. Otherwise the prospective result does not replicate. No threshold changes after enrollment begins.

robustness.leaveOneCompanionCaseOut: Report the incremental contrast after excluding each companion case one at a time. This is descriptive robustness only; no outlier exclusion is allowed in the primary estimate.
robustness.calendarDesignationStratum: Report companion contrast separately inside/outside calendar_designation when sample size permits, because prior periods show partial overlap.
robustness.secondReadingStratum: Report companion contrast separately inside/outside second_reading when sample size permits, because the 2025-2026 holdout had overlap with the single large negative companion case.

prospective2027_2028.analysisTiming: Single end-of-evaluation reveal after the enrolled source/mechanics/Quick artifacts are frozen. No sequential peeking for threshold adjustment.
prospective2027_2028.actionability: A successful prospective replication still nominates a separately reviewed calibration experiment; it does not directly write a production weight.
